proposal.root_cause: The recent refactor removed tax from the total calculation in src/pricing.js, causing the total amount to be lower than expected by the Playwright test.
proposal.explanation: The test expects the total price to include tax (e.g., '$61.56'), but the commit changed the totalCents computation to exclude tax (taxCents). Restoring the original behavior by adding taxCents back to totalCents will make the total match the expected value.
proposal.pr_title: Fix total calculation to include tax
proposal.pr_summary: Reintroduce tax addition in totalCents calculation within src/pricing.js to ensure totals match expected values in tests.
